items.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
items.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

items.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
items.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.
